'''Jorol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Jorol appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as one of the endgame PvE gear vendor for the Jedi Consular class; his actual title has varied as the tier has been relabeled over the game's history, and he has been added and removed from various worlds as well.<ref name="TOR" /> He was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, he remains in the game, as his character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
